source: the stylesheet bodies read during live signed-out loads of glossgenius.com / (the Webflow CDN bundle + marketing-assets + inline <style> blocks), app.glossgenius.com /login (the Next.js CSS chunks) and honeyhivesalon.glossgenius.com /services (a real published booking site's chunks), re-parsed with CSSStyleSheet; resolved in per-host probes carrying each host's first-party sheets at 1440 x 900 with the page's own scope classes replayed (.light, .tokens_glossDS__*) — every surface is light-only (no dark media query, no theme attribute). Third-party sheets (the decagon.ai chat widget, reCAPTCHA, icon fonts) are harvested under `external` for provenance only: never resolved, never part of a token set

properties.--font-family: "Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

properties.--widget-streaming-chat-bubble-mask: linear-gradient(to right, black 0%, black 33.333%, transparent 66.667%, transparent 100%)

external.selector: .prose-headings\:text-fg-default-primary :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, th):not(:where([class~="not-prose"], [class~="not-prose"] *))
.prose-headings\:text-fg-default-secondary :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, th):not(:where([class~="not-prose"], [class~="not-prose"] *))
.prose-headings\:text-gray-900 :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, th):not(:where([class~="not-prose"], [class~="not-prose"] *))

fonts.src: url(…) format("woff2"), url(…) format("woff"), url(…) format("truetype")
url(…) format("woff2"), url(…) format("woff"), url(…) format("truetype")
